You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that creates a comprehensive sorting algorithms visualizer.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Implement 5 sorting algorithms: Bubble, Quick, Merge, Heap, Radix
- Visual bars with color coding: red (comparing), yellow (swapping), green (sorted), blue (pivot)
- Algorithm selection dropdown and speed control slider
- Toggle between step-by-step and continuous modes
- Real-time complexity analysis display (O-notation)
- Scramble button with patterns: Random, Reverse, Nearly Sorted
- Call stack depth visualization for recursive algorithms
- Real-time comparison and swap counters
- Working area highlighting for divide-and-conquer
- Smooth 60 FPS performance, no external libraries

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

<script>
function initSortVisualizer(canvasId) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    canvas.width = 500;
    canvas.height = 500;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    const container = document.createElement('div');
    container.style.display = 'flex';
    container.style.flexDirection = 'column';
    container.style.alignItems = 'center';
    document.body.insertBefore(container, canvas);

    const controls = document.createElement('div');
    controls.style.display = 'flex';
    controls.style.alignItems = 'center';
    controls.style.gap = '10px';
    container.appendChild(controls);

    const algoSelect = document.createElement('select');
    ['Bubble', 'Quick', 'Merge', 'Heap', 'Radix'].forEach(name => {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = name;
        opt.textContent = name;
        algoSelect.appendChild(opt);
    });
    controls.appendChild(algoSelect);

    const complexityDisplay = document.createElement('span');
    controls.appendChild(complexityDisplay);

    const speedLabel = document.createElement('label');
    speedLabel.textContent = 'Speed: ';
    const speedSlider = document.createElement('input');
    speedSlider.type = 'range';
    speedSlider.min = '1';
    speedSlider.max = '5';
    speedSlider.value = '3';
    speedLabel.appendChild(speedSlider);
    controls.appendChild(speedLabel);

    const stepToggle = document.createElement('label');
    stepToggle.textContent = 'Step Mode';
    const stepCheckbox = document.createElement('input');
    stepCheckbox.type = 'checkbox';
    stepToggle.appendChild(stepCheckbox);
    controls.appendChild(stepToggle);

    const nextStepButton = document.createElement('button');
    nextStepButton.textContent = 'Next Step';
    nextStepButton.disabled = true;
    controls.appendChild(nextStepButton);

    const startButton = document.createElement('button');
    startButton.textContent = 'Start';
    controls.appendChild(startButton);

    const scrambleSelect = document.createElement('select');
    ['Random', 'Reverse', 'Nearly Sorted'].forEach(name => {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = name;
        opt.textContent = name;
        scrambleSelect.appendChild(opt);
    });
    controls.appendChild(scrambleSelect);

    const scrambleButton = document.createElement('button');
    scrambleButton.textContent = 'Scramble';
    controls.appendChild(scrambleButton);

    const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
    statusDiv.style.marginTop = '10px';
    statusDiv.style.textAlign = 'center';
    container.appendChild(statusDiv);

    const info = document.createElement('div');
    info.style.marginTop = '5px';
    info.style.textAlign = 'center';
    container.appendChild(info);

    let arr = [];
    let n = 100;
    let comparisons = 0;
    let swaps = 0;
    let callStackDepth = 0;
    let sortedSet = new Set();
    let comparing = null;
    let swapping = null;
    let pivotIdx = null;
    let workingArea = null;
    let algorithm = 'Bubble';
    let speed = 3;
    let stepMode = false;
    let pauseResolver = null;
    let abortFlag = false;
    const complexityMap = {
        'Bubble': 'O(n²)',
        'Quick': 'O(n log n)',
        'Merge': 'O(n log n)',
        'Heap': 'O(n log n)',
        'Radix': 'O(nk)'
    };

    function resetState() {
        comparisons = 0;
        swaps = 0;
        callStackDepth = 0;
        sortedSet.clear();
        comparing = null;
        swapping = null;
        pivotIdx = null;
        workingArea = null;
        abortFlag = false;
    }

    function render() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        const w = canvas.width / n;
 const maxVal = Math.max(...arr);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            let h = (arr[i] / maxVal) * canvas.height;
            let x = i * w;
            let y = canvas.height - h;
            if (comparing && i === comparing[0] || comparable && i === comparing[1]) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
            } else if (swapping && (i === swapping[0] || i === swapping[1])) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
            } else if (sortedSet.has(i)) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'green';
            } else if (pivotIdx === i) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
            } else {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
            }
            ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
        }
        if (workingArea) {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,200,0,0.3)';
            ctx.fillRect(workingArea.low * w, 0, (workingArea.high - workingArea.low + 1) * w, canvas.height);
        }
    }

    function updateInfo() {
        info.textContent = `Comparisons: ${comparisons} | Swaps: ${swaps} | Depth: ${callStackDepth}`;
    }

    function getDelay() {
        return Math.max(100, 600 / speed);
    }

    function pause() {
        return new Promise(resolve => {
            if (!stepMode) {
                setTimeout(resolve, getDelay());
            } else {
                pauseResolver = resolve;
                nextStepButton.disabled = false;
            }
        });
    }

    nextStepButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (pauseResolver) {
            pauseResolver();
            pauseResolver = null;
            nextStepButton.disabled = true;
        }
    });

    function swapIndices(i, j) {
        const temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
    }

    async function compareIndices(i, j) {
        if (abortFlag) return;
        comparisons++;
        comparing = [i, j];
        render();
        updateInfo();
        await pause();
        comparing = null;
    }

    async function swapIndicesAsync(i, j) {
        if (abortFlag) return;
        swaps++;
        swapping = [i, j];
        render();
        updateInfo();
        await pause();
        swapIndices(i, j);
        swapping = null;
        render();
        updateInfo();
        await pause();
    }

    async function bubbleSort() {
        for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            for (let j = 0; j < n - i - 1; j++) {
                await compareIndices(j, j + 1);
                if (arr[j] > arr[j + 1]) {
                    await swapIndicesAsync(j, j + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) sortedSet.add(i);
    }

    async function quickSort(low, high) {
        if (abortFlag) return;
        if (low < high) {
            callStackDepth++;
            const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
            pivotIdx = mid;
            working high };
            render();
            updateInfo();
            await pause();
            const pi = await partition(low, high);
            pivotIdx = null;
            workingArea = null;
            await quickSort(low, pi - 1);
            await quickSort(pi, high);
            callStackDepth--;
        } else if (low >= 0 && low < n) {
            sortedSet.add(low);
        }
    }

    async function partition(low, high) {
        const pivotVal = arr[Math.floor((low + high) / 2)];
        let i = low;
        let j = high;
        while (i <= j) {
            while (arr[i] < pivotVal) i++;
            while (arr[j] > pivotVal) j--;
            if (i <= j) {
                await compareIndices(i, j);
                if (i < j) await swapIndicesAsync(i, j);
                i++; j--;
            }
 }

    async function mergeSort(low, high) {
        if (abortFlag) return;
        if (low < high) {
            callStackDepth++;
            const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
            workingArea = { low, high };
            render();
            updateInfo();
            await pause();
            await mergeSort(low, mid);
            await mergeSort(mid + 1, high);
            await merge(low, mid, high);
            workingArea = null;
            callStackDepth--;
        }
    }

    async function merge(l, m, h) {
        const left = arr.slice(l, m + 1);
        const right = arr.slice(m + 1, h + 1);
        let i = 0, j = 0, k = l;
        while (i < left.length && j < right.length) {
            await compareIndices(l + i, m + 1 + j);
            if (left[i] <= right[j]) {
                arr[k++] = left[i++];
            } else {
                arr[k++] = right[j++];
            }
            swaps++;
            rendering();
            await pause();
        }
        while (i < left.length) {
            arr[k++] = left[i++];
            swaps++;
            rendering();
            await pause();
        }
        while (j < right.length) {
            arr[k++] = right[j++];
            swaps++;
            rendering();
            await pause();
        }
    }

    async function heapSort() {
        for (let i = Math.floor(n / 2) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (abortFlag) return;
            await heapify(n, i);
        }
        for (let i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            if (abortFlag) return;
            await swapIndicesAsync(0, i);
            sortedSet.add(i);
        }
        sortedSet.add(0);
    }

    async function heapify(size, root) {
        if (abortFlag) return;
        let largest = root;
        const l = 2 * root + 1;
        const r = 2 * root + 2;
        if (l < size) {
            await compareIndices(largest, l);
            if (arr[l] > arr[largest]) largest = l;
        }
        if (r < size) {
            await compareIndices(largest, r);
            if (arr[r] > arr[largest]) largest = r;
        }
        if (largest !== root) {
            await swapIndicesAsync(root, largest);
            await heapify(size, largest);
        }
    }

    async function radixSort() {
        const max = Math.max(...arr);
        let exp = 1;
        while (Math.floor(max / exp) > 0) {
            if (abortFlag) return;
            await countingSort(exp);
            exp *= 10;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) sortedSet.add(i);
    }

    async function countingSort(exp) {
        const output = new Array(n).fill(0);
        const count = new Array(10).fill(0);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const idx = Math.floor(arr[i] / exp) % 10;
            count[idx]++;
        }
        for (let i = 1; i < 10; i++) {
            count[i] += count[i - 1];
        }
        for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const idx = Math.floor(arr[i] / exp) % 10;
            output[--count[idx]] = arr[i];
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = output[i];
            swaps++;
            render();
            updateInfo();
            await pause();
        }
    }

    async function runAlgorithm() {
        if (abortFlag) return;
        resetState();
        render();
        switch (algorithm) {
            case 'Bubble': await bubbleSort(); break;
            case 'Quick': await quickSort(0, n - 1); break;
            case 'Merge': await mergeSort(0, n - 1); break;
            case 'Heap': await heapSort(); break;
            case await radixSort(); break;
        }
        sortedSet = new Set([...Array(n).keys()]);
        render();
        updateInfo();
        abortFlag = true;
    }

    function scrambleArray(pattern) {
        switch (pattern) {
            case 'Random':
                for (let i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                    [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
                }
                break;
            case 'Reverse':
                arr = arr.slice().reverse();
                break;
            case 'Nearly Sorted':
                for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    arr[i] = i + 1;
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < Math.floor(n * 0.1); i++) {
                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
                    const k = Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
                    [arr[j], arr[k]] = [arr[k], arr[j]];
                }
                break;
        }
        render();
        updateInfo();
    }

    algoSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
        algorithm = algoSelect.value;
        complexityDisplay.textContent = `${algorithm} (${complexityMap[algorithm]})`;
    });

    speedSlider.addEventListener('input', () => {
        speed = Number(speedSlider.value);
    });

    stepCheckbox.addEventListener('change', () => {
        stepMode = stepCheckbox.checked;
        nextStepButton.disabled = !stepMode;
    });

    startButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        abortFlag = true;
        setTimeout(async () => {
            abortFlag = false;
            await runAlgorithm();
        }, 10);
    });

    scrambleButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        scrambleArray(scrambleSelect.value);
    });

    // init
    scrambleArray('Random');
    complexityDisplay.textContent = `${algorithm} (${complexityMap[algorithm]})`;
    updateInfo();
    render();
}
</script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css"/>

(The JavaScript code above is the complete function. To use it, call `initSortVisualizer('myCanvas')` after creating a `<canvas id="myCanvas"></canvas>` element.)
